mapper.select: SELECT t1.label, IFNULL(t2.num, 0) AS num FROM ( SELECT 1 AS `year`, (DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') - 9) AS label UNION SELECT 2 AS `year`, (DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') - 8) AS label UNION SELECT 3 AS `year`, (DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') - 7) AS label UNION SELECT 4 AS `year`, (DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') - 6) AS label UNION SELECT 5 AS `year`, (DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') - 5) AS label UNION SELECT 6 AS `year`, (DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') - 4) AS label UNION SELECT 7 AS `year`, (DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') - 3) AS label UNION SELECT 8 AS `year`, (DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') - 2) AS label UNION SELECT 9 AS `year`, (DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') - 1) AS label UNION SELECT 10 AS `year`, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') AS label) t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT dataTable.year AS year, SUM(today_all) AS num FROM vm_statistics_event_num_year dataTable WHERE 1 = 1 ${param.dataScope} GROUP BY dataTable.year ORDER BY dataTable.year) t2 ON t1.label = t2.year ORDER BY t1.label

SELECT t1.label, IFNULL(t2.num, 0) AS num FROM ( SELECT 1 AS `month`, '1' AS label UNION SELECT 2 AS `month`, '2' AS label UNION SELECT 3 AS `month`, '3' AS label UNION SELECT 4 AS `month`, '4' AS label UNION SELECT 5 AS `month`, '5' AS label UNION SELECT 6 AS `month`, '6' AS label UNION SELECT 7 AS `month`, '7' AS label UNION SELECT 8 AS `month`, '8' AS label UNION SELECT 9 AS `month`, '9' AS label UNION SELECT 10 AS `month`, '10' AS label UNION SELECT 11 AS `month`, '11' AS label UNION SELECT 12 AS `month`, '12' AS label) t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT dataTable.month AS month, SUM(today_all) AS num FROM vm_statistics_event_num_month dataTable WHERE DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date , '%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW() , '%Y') ${param.dataScope} GROUP BY dataTable.month ORDER BY dataTable.month) t2 ON t1.month = t2.month ORDER BY t1.month

SELECT t1.label, IFNULL(t2.num, 0) AS num FROM ( SELECT 1 AS `day`, '1' AS label UNION SELECT 2 AS `day`, '2' AS label UNION SELECT 3 AS `day`, '3' AS label UNION SELECT 4 AS `day`, '4' AS label UNION SELECT 5 AS `day`, '5' AS label UNION SELECT 6 AS `day`, '6' AS label UNION SELECT 7 AS `day`, '7' AS label UNION SELECT 8 AS `day`, '8' AS label UNION SELECT 9 AS `day`, '9' AS label UNION SELECT 10 AS `day`, '10' AS label UNION SELECT 11 AS `day`, '11' AS label UNION SELECT 12 AS `day`, '12' AS label UNION SELECT 13 AS `day`, '13' AS label UNION SELECT 14 AS `day`, '14' AS label UNION SELECT 15 AS `day`, '15' AS label UNION SELECT 16 AS `day`, '16' AS label UNION SELECT 17 AS `day`, '17' AS label UNION SELECT 18 AS `day`, '18' AS label UNION SELECT 19 AS `day`, '19' AS label UNION SELECT 20 AS `day`, '20' AS label UNION SELECT 21 AS `day`, '21' AS label UNION SELECT 22 AS `day`, '22' AS label UNION SELECT 23 AS `day`, '23' AS label UNION SELECT 24 AS `day`, '24' AS label UNION SELECT 25 AS `day`, '25' AS label UNION SELECT 26 AS `day`, '26' AS label UNION SELECT 27 AS `day`, '27' AS label UNION SELECT 28 AS `day`, '28' AS label UNION SELECT 29 AS `day`, '29' AS label UNION SELECT 30 AS `day`, '30' AS label UNION SELECT 31 AS `day`, '31' AS label) t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT dataTable.day AS day, SUM(today_all) AS num FROM vm_statistics_event_num_day dataTable WHERE DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') ${param.dataScope} GROUP BY dataTable.day ORDER BY dataTable.day) t2 ON t1.day = t2.day ORDER BY t1.day

SELECT dataTable.longitude, dataTable.latitude, SUM(dataTable.warning_num) AS num FROM vm_statistics_event_therm_diagram dataTable WHERE 1 = 1 ${param.dataScope} GROUP BY dataTable.latitude, dataTable.longitude

SELECT sum(dataTable.today_all) alarmNum, province_id code FROM (select t.province_id as province_code, t.city_id as city_code,t.* from vm_statistics_event_num_day_tt t) dataTable WHERE dataTable.province_id in
#{item.code}
AND dataTable.create_date >= DATE_FORMAT(#{param.webStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AND dataTable.create_date <= DATE_FORMAT(#{param.webEndDate}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' )
group by province_id

SELECT sum(dataTable.today_all) alarmNum, dataTable.city_id code FROM (select t.province_id as province_code, t.city_id as city_code,t.* from vm_statistics_event_num_day_tt t) dataTable WHERE dataTable.city_id in
#{item.code}
AND dataTable.create_date >= DATE_FORMAT(#{param.webStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AND dataTable.create_date <= DATE_FORMAT(#{param.webEndDate}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' )
group by dataTable.city_id
